title: Unit Event — Chasing The Sparkle Beyond the Blue Sky — Episode8 Wishing Our Show Succeeds!

meta.Event: Chasing The Sparkle Beyond the Blue Sky
meta.Event Outline: Feeling the need for further practice leading up to their solo show, MORE MORE JUMP! decide to do a training camp that doubles as a streaming project. They start doing a variety of exercises under a special program devised by Airi, but something seems to be worrying Minori...

rows.Line: The next morning
Beach

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, how's this camera angle...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Good morning, Airi. You're up awfully early.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
MEIKO!
I could say the same for you.
Are the others already awake?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<No, they're still asleep.
I was wondering if you were setting up an early-morning prank, so I came to take a peek.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: H-How did you know...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Oh, I was right?
I suppose I have been to a few more training camps and been an idol for longer...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Nothing gets past you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Also, it's not really a prank per se...
I just thought that I could whip up a nice, healthy breakfast for everyone.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Oh, that sounds lovely!
Does that mean you're going to be doing a cooking stream?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. Initially, I thought it would've been fun to make dinner together yesterday and stream it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I didn't feel too great about having everyone do that after a long day of working out. So, I decided to do a breakfast stream on my own.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Oh, I see.
You're always being so kind.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <At the same time, this is you we're talking about, Airi... This isn't going to be any ordinary breakfast that you'll be streaming, will it?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Bullseye!
I have something special planned for our viewers at the end of our cooking segment!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Something special?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. The rest you'll just have to find out by watching, so I hope you get a chance to join us!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Oh, that's just making me even more curious!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Now I'm really looking forward to seeing what you have planned♪>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, the camera's all set, so let's... Start!
song00004_off_f

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Good morning, everyone!
Do we have any early birds in the house?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yes! An early-morning stream!>
<I didn't know when you'd be back, so I've been waiting this entire time.>
<Is it just you, Airi? Are the others still asleep?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks, you guys.
I really appreciate you joining me at this time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And yes, the others are still asleep.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
The thing is...
I've decided to whip up some breakfast in secret for them!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Oh, breakfast cooked by Airi. I bet it'll be a healthy, balanced one.>
<I think I'll make myself some breakfast too.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, nice!
Let's cook together!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: First, I'll be frying up some slices of salmon. As for prep... I'll be using these ones that I put in a light salt and sake marinade fifteen minutes before this stream began.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Way to go, Airi! She's always prepared!>
<Fifteen minutes is pretty long. You'd have to turn your cooking stream into a talk show to fill that gap.>
<Does the place you're staying at not offer a complimentary breakfast?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, the plan we picked for the cottage we're staying at did include a breakfast option.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I decided to not choose it since I saw that there was an outdoor kitchen, which seemed much more enjoyable.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, my frying pan seems just about ready, so let's start cooking these up. Now, a word of precaution...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There's a lot of fat under the skin, so be mindful of the oil that drips off and spatters as it hits the surface of the pan. Remember, everyone, safety first!
se_event_blue_2022_002

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yeah, the skin's always tricky to deal with.>
<It's interesting how there's so much fat there and not so much in the actual meat.>
<Do you guys like to eat the skin or set it aside?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I'd like to know what you guys like as well! As for me, I really love salmon skin!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And look at that! They're coming along really nicely. Now, I'll be turning off the stove to let them rest a bit, while I bring over the veggies I just chopped up...
se_event_blue_2022_002

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The ones for the miso soup will go straight into that pot, I can put the salad veggies onto their plates and... Voila! Just like that, two dishes are ready! Easy, right?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That was so fast...>
<You're a total pro, Airi...>
<I wanna try your miso soup, Airi.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. You guys are making me blush.
Anyway, since we're just waiting on the miso soup now...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Here's a special segment!
“Let's Make Some Break-A-Leg Smoothies” in the hopes that our solo show succeeds!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Oh, here we go lol>
<I knew there was more to this than just cooking.>
<Smoothies? Do you mean...?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Some of you already seem to know what's going on. I'll need you guys to write in the comments about which ingredients I bought at random should go into our smoothies...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll throw the four most popular ones, along with three of my choosing, into the blender! After it's all mixed up, we'll all drink it together!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yay! We get to choose!>
<Wait, there's no guarantee that our choices will mix well...>
<Fruits, vegetables, tofu... There's a lot to choose from...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. It's more fun when you spice up a cooking segment like this, right? So, let's start by choosing our first ingredient!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay...
That should do it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
This looks...interesting.
I sorta regret buying the things I did now that I'm seeing what I'll actually be drinking...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<You'll be fine! It's full of healthy ingredients!>
<You can do it, Airi!>
<I can't wait to see how you all react lol>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You guys are hilarious...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good morning, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Hey, they're awake!>
<Haruka, Minori, good morning!>
<Whoa, Shizuku's like the sun! Does she always shine so brilliantly every morning?!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Mhm... Morning, Airi...
My muscles are so sore... And my tummy...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Are you streaming right now?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Streaming...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Y-You're streaming this...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yeah, I am.
It's a surprise stream where I make breakfast for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Really...?!
You're making breakfast for us?! I feel so blessed...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: M-Me too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I... I should've fixed my bed head first! What if I pressed it down with my hands?! Please work! Please!)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Minori's got mad bed head lol>
<Not sure hiding will do you much good.>
<Why not just let your hair be for today? Haha>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: ...is what they're saying, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No...!
I wasn't expecting this at all!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Still, you got up early to make breakfast for us... We would've helped if you let us know.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then it wouldn't be much of a surprise, would it?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
For now, let's set that aside...
Bon appetit...is what I would say, but I have another surprise laying in wait!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, there's more?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup. With the help of our viewers, I whipped up some “break-a-leg smoothies” in the hopes that our solo show succeeds.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll be drinking those before digging into breakfast!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Can't wait! Let's go!>
<What's it gonna taste like...?>
<It might not look good, but drinking it will show that you're all committed.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I can't help but feel a little worried after reading these comments...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, relax.
Just think of these smoothies as being filled with their love.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm not sure I feel better...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: S-So, where are these smoothies?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Here.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
This color...
Are these actually drinkable...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um... May I ask what went into these...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Super healthy ingredients that our viewers and I chose.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Bitter melons, natto, green chilis, mushrooms... With a mix of sweet fruits picked by me to round out the flavor!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-What's this going to taste like...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Are you really sure about this, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I can't believe we got to choose the ingredients.>
<Please try it! Hurry!>
<I hope it doesn't K.O. them lol...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If everyone really did help make these, then we probably should drink them...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Exactly.
Especially since we made these in the hopes that our solo show will succeed, so we absolutely have to drink them!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right down to the last drop!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay... But I still don't feel great about this...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Here goes nothing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-It's actually pretty good...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Not quite what I was expecting based on this color. It's hard to call it delectable, but it kind of tastes like one of those flavored protein shakes...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And if this is good for my health, I'm willing to drink it every day.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Whoa, cool! After putting in so much weird stuff...!>
<Honestly, I was expecting it to taste horrible lol.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I know some of you out there are a bit disappointed, but I'm actually really glad that these turned out better than expected!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (To be fair, I made sure that I'd be able to cover for whatever they chose by adjusting the flavor on my end...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whew... That was good!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I feel healthier already after drinking that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much.
I believe we enjoyed it quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I guess it's good that they didn't taste bad. Otherwise, we wouldn't have gotten to see your smiles.>
<This means your show's guaranteed to succeed.>
<That was a great segment! Thank you, Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm glad you all liked it  so much.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Now, let's have some breakfast.
Our training camp stream's about to come to a close, but I hope you'll stay with us until the end! Enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Oh, right... It's already been 24 hours...>
<You did an amazing job, Airi.>
<That's because Airi's a genius when it comes to this stuff.>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <I'm a huge Shizuku fan, but I see now that Airi's a vital part of MMJ.>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I can't wait to see your next idea.>
<Please do another 24-hour stream sometime.>
<I wanna see you girls train more!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's gonna be hard to match this hype, but I promise to come up with more fun stuff for us to do! So stay tuned!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. You really are the best, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I need to thank you as well.
This training camp was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Don't thank me just yet...
We still haven't had breakfast.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, let's get going!
Shizuku, serve the rice into the bowl. Haruka, you're on tea duty. And you carry everything out, Minori. This is a team-building exercise! We gotta move as a unit!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa, Airi's in drill instructor mode!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Until just recently, I was certain that I'd never be able to be an idol and do stuff like this ever again.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (If the girl from back then were to see me now, she'd probably feel pretty disillusioned and say, “This isn't what I wanted!”)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But I couldn't be happier with what I have now because I have true friends by my side. Friends who recognize me for who I am...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Does this look like a good amount of rice for everyone?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's perfect.
The tea's also just about ready, so I'll carry it over now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, I'll carry the rice Shizuku's serving for us! Oh, I need to engage my core since we're still training...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (It wasn't all roses and sunshine, but I know now that none of my efforts went to waste.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (So, moving forward...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Airi!
The food's all ready!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks...
Alright, everyone, good work for making it until the end.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After everything we did, the world's our oyster now. That just leaves practicing as much as we can until the day of our show...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's make it the best solo show that anyone's ever seen!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's keep doing our best until then!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Anyway, let's have breakfast.
We need to work as a team here too, so stay focused until the end.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Put your hands together and get ready to...

rows.Speaker: Minori, Shizuku, Airi & Haruka
rows.Line: Dig in!
